patch.role: Repairs the shared XML edge object: re-applies the slice mutation only when the object does not already carry a slices child.
lines: if not G.is_directed() and not edge_element.findall("slices"):

inputs.expose_directed_slices: directed edge carrying slices data (repair not declared)
inputs.control_undirected_no_slices: undirected edge without slices data; A is a no-op

rationale: A mutates the shared edge_element by appending a slices child.  U1 inspects that object state and re-applies the mutation only when the child is absent.  The repair is declared for undirected graphs; the directed case exposes the deletion (the unconsumed slices entry then breaks attribute serialisation).
